title: Kohereza abarwayi
subtitle: Abarwayi bose boherejwe na {{facility}}: kurikirana kwemerwa, gahunda no kurangiza bifite ibimenyetso.
overdueHint: Byabazwe uhereye ku itariki ntarengwa yashyizweho n'umuntu. "Byarengeje igihe" ntabwo ari imiterere ibikwa.

kpi.label: Incamake yo kohereza abarwayi
kpi.medianHint: Kuva bisabwe kugeza birangiye bifite ibimenyetso — imibare ya demo

filters.searchPlaceholder: Izina ry'umurwayi, nimero cyangwa aho yoherejwe

actions.edit: Hindura aho yoherejwe cyangwa itariki ntarengwa

drawer.title: Kohereza
drawer.denied: Uku kohereza kuri hanze y'ikigo nderabuzima ukoreramo. Iki gikorwa cyanditswe mu gitabo cy'igenzura.
drawer.reviewNoDecision: Nta cyemezo cyanditswe kuri iri suzuma.
drawer.historyUnavailable: Amateka ntiyashoboye gufunguka. Kohereza ubwako kugaragara hejuru.
drawer.terminal: Uku kohereza kwarafunzwe. Nta yindi mpinduka ishoboka.
drawer.noPermission: Inshingano yawe ntiyemerewe guhindura kohereza. Ushobora kugusoma.
drawer.destinationOnly: Uku kohereza kwoherejwe ku kigo cyawe n'ikindi kigo. Ikigo cyohereje ni cyo cyonyine gishobora kuguhindura.
drawer.offline: Nta murandasi. Impinduka zahagaritswe; kohereza bikomeza gusomeka.

dialog.failed: Nta cyatakaye: ibyo wanditse biracyahari. Ongera ugerageze — icyifuzo kimwe cyoherezwa, ntigishobora kubikwa kabiri.

update.scheduleBody: Andika itariki n'isaha bya gahunda byumvikanyweho n'ikigo yoherejwemo.
update.editTitle: Hindura aho yoherejwe cyangwa itariki ntarengwa
update.editBody: Ibyari bisanzweho bigumishwa mu mateka yo kohereza.
update.dueAtHint: Ishyirwaho nawe, isaha ya Africa/Kigali. Nta gihe cya protocole gikoreshwa.

complete.title: Rangiza kohereza ufite ibimenyetso
complete.description: Kurangiza bisaba itariki, umusaruro n'ubwoko bw'ikimenyetso bwemewe hamwe na nimero yacyo.
complete.notEvidenceNotice: Kohereza ubutumwa bwibutsa cyangwa ubundi butumwa ntabwo ari ikimenyetso cyo kurangiza.
complete.completedAtHint: Igihe umurwayi yitabiriye (ntibirenge ubu). Isaha ya Africa/Kigali.
complete.evidenceReferenceHint: Urugero: umurongo mu gitabo cyangwa nimero y'urupapuro rwo kugaruka.
complete.confirmBody: Kohereza kuzafungwa nk'ukwarangiye hamwe n'iki kimenyetso.

cancel.title: Hagarika kohereza
cancel.description: Guhagarika bifunga kohereza. Hanyuma hashobora gushyirwaho ukundi kohereza ku isuzuma rimwe.

create.title: Ohereza umurwayi
create.description: Ku isuzuma ryafatiwe icyemezo ritagira kohereza kutararangira.
create.reviewHint: Hagaragara gusa amasuzuma yafatiwe ibyemezo atagira kohereza kutararangira (ibimenyetso byakuweho ntibirimo).
create.noneEligible: Nta suzuma ryafatiwe icyemezo ritagira kohereza kutararangira.

conflict.title: Uku kohereza kwahindutse kuva wagufungura
conflict.body: Undi muntu yabitse verisiyo nshya. Nta cyasimbujwe. Fungura verisiyo iheruka uyisuzume mbere yo kongera kugerageza.

errors.alreadyOpen: Iri suzuma risanzwe rifite kohereza kutararangira. Hemewe kohereza kumwe gusa kutararangira ku isuzuma.
errors.invalidTransition: Iyi mpinduka ntishoboka uhereye ku miterere y'ubu yo kohereza.
